note: 身份：Serves as one of the main NPCs in the Mage Faction Questline. 常驻： Cathedral / -16, 123, -882.5。与玩家关系：会随阵营、任务阶段或交易状态变化。说话层次：按 Wiki 原对白的身份与情绪自然口语化，不套统一客服腔。核心性格：仅从原文呈现，不额外添加人物关系或任务事实。固定词汇/禁用：NPC 人名与自造品牌保留英文；阵营、地名和机制沿用项目术语；不硬塞网络梗。

messages.context: Dean：Not in or trying to join the Mage Faction | Random；Dean：Not in the Mage Faction or completing the Mage Questline | Random
messages.text: I am busy right now.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我现在很忙。

messages.context: Dean：First trying to join the Mage Faction
messages.text: You... are not one of my students!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你……不是我的学生!

messages.context: Dean：First trying to join the Mage Faction
messages.text: I hope you are not here to rob me, I could still take on a dozen of young guns like you!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 希望你不是来抢劫的。像你这样的年轻人,来一打我也能收拾!

messages.context: Dean：First trying to join the Mage Faction
messages.text: Oh, that's not why you are here? Then why are you here? Speak up I don't have all day!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,不是来抢劫的?那你到底来干什么?快说,我可没空耗一整天!

messages.context: Dean：First trying to join the Mage Faction；Dean：Before showing the  Maddox Batphone
messages.text: [YOU] I have something to show you: [CLICK TO SHOW]
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: [你] 我有样东西给你看: [点击展示]

messages.context: Dean：Before showing the  Maddox Batphone
messages.text: You again, what do you want this time?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 又是你,这次想干什么?

messages.context: Dean：Upon showing the  Maddox Batphone
messages.text: Oh, where did you find this? This looks like an older, simpler version of our Ability Phones, in a way this is remarkable.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,这是从哪儿找到的?看起来像是技能手机更古老、更简陋的版本……某种意义上还挺了不起。

messages.context: Dean：Upon showing the  Maddox Batphone
messages.text: But why do you have this, are you interested in that kind of magical technology?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 可你为什么会拿着它?你对这类魔法科技感兴趣?

messages.context: Dean：Selecting [NO]
messages.text: Oh, you mean...you are more interested in advanced magical technology right?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,你的意思是……你更喜欢先进的魔法科技,对吧?

messages.context: Dean：Before selecting [YES]
messages.text: Have you changed your mind?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 改变主意了吗?

messages.context: Dean：Selecting [NO]
messages.text: In that case thanks for the gift, and have a great life.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那就谢谢你的礼物了。祝你往后生活愉快。

messages.context: Dean：Selecting [YES]
messages.text: Perfect, well then you are at the right place, let me write you a letter of recommendation!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 太好了,那你来对地方了。我给你写封推荐信!

messages.context: Dean：Selecting [YES]
messages.text: Hold on...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 稍等……

messages.context: Dean：Selecting [YES]
messages.text: Here take this!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 来,拿好!

messages.context: Dean：After accepting the  Letter of Recommendation
messages.text: First you should go to the Queen with it, we have a very strict code around here and you won't go far without the Queen's approval.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 先把信交给女王。这里规矩森严,没有女王批准,你哪儿也去不了。

messages.context: Dean：After accepting the  Letter of Recommendation
messages.text: Hopefully the Queen will grant you access to some parts of the city.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 希望女王会准许你进入城里的部分区域。

messages.context: Dean：After accepting the  Letter of Recommendation
messages.text: Once that's done, go visit my cousin Udel in his shop in the plaza.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 办完后,去广场的店里找我表亲 Udel。

messages.context: Dean：After accepting the  Letter of Recommendation
messages.text: I'll let him know you are coming and he'll make you a price for your own Abiphone.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我会通知他你要来,他会给你的专属 Abiphone 开个价。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving the  Letter of Recommendation to  Queen Nyx
messages.text: You should bring that letter to the Queen ASAP. Did you lose the letter?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你该尽快把信交给女王。难道把信弄丢了?

messages.context: Dean：Selecting [NO]  ([YES] will open the claim menu)
messages.text: Alright, if you are struggling to find the Queen, she is usually in the throne room, or in her quarters.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 好吧,要是找不到女王,她通常在王座厅或自己的房间。

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after buying one
messages.text: ✆ Oh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 哦,是你! 女王已经接纳你加入我们的阵营了?太好了!

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after buying one
messages.text: ✆ Listen, I don't have a ton of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 听着,我现在没多少时间——正在研究的东西刚刚被偷了!

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after buying one
messages.text: ✆ I'm sorry, but I'll have to call you back later. Enjoy your Abiphone!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 抱歉,晚点再回电。好好享受你的 Abiphone!

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after acquiring the stolen research
messages.text: ✆ Oh %s is that you again?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 哦,%s,又是你吗?

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after acquiring the stolen research
messages.text: ✆ I am still really stressed out about the long research.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 那项长期研究还是让我焦头烂额。

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after acquiring the stolen research
messages.text: ✆ It's a long story but in short, we believe the Piglins stole it, it's a real problem.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 说来话长。简单讲,我们认为东西是猪灵偷走的,麻烦大了。

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after acquiring the stolen research
messages.text: ✆ What did you just say? You recovered it? And they didn't even see you?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 你刚才说什么?你把它找回来了?而且他们根本没发现你?

messages.context: Dean：Calling with an Abiphone after acquiring the stolen research
messages.text: ✆ I can't believe it, you are truly a hero! I'm currently near the Community Center, please come here and bring the research back.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 真不敢相信,你简直是英雄! 我现在就在社区中心附近,请过来把研究资料交还给我们。

messages.context: Dean：In the  Mage Council, after the meeting
messages.text: Salt is immensely important, this is quite the revolution for us!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 盐实在太重要了,这对我们称得上一场革命!

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: I can't thank you enough, what you did was heroic!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 怎么感谢你都不够,你做的事堪称英雄之举!

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: You are probably aware but we used to be Pig farmers but Sulphur turned our pigs into Piglins.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你可能已经知道,我们过去养猪为生,却是硫磺把猪变成了猪灵。

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: For decades we had to survive with almost nothing to eat, until we learned magic.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 几十年来,我们几乎找不到可吃的东西,直到学会魔法才熬过来。

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: Piglins can eat nether warts, but we certainly can't!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 猪灵能吃下界疣,我们可绝对不行!

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: Anyways, if you want to learn more about that, there are books in the Academy regarding the Dark Ages.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 总之,想了解更多的话,学院里有讲述黑暗时代的书。

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: I am trying to finish my work on this machine but my Apprentice is missing.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我正想完成这台机器,可我的学徒失踪了。

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: He is out there in the wild looking for precious ingredients and he should have been back a long time ago.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 他外出寻找珍贵原料,早就该回来了。

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: Their Abiphone doesn't seem to be working, I am starting to get worried.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 他的 Abiphone 似乎也坏了,我越来越担心。

messages.context: Dean：Back in the  Cathedral, after the meeting
messages.text: Would you be so kind to look for them, they are probably North of that Red Sand Desert.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 能劳烦你去找找他吗?他多半在那片红沙沙漠北边。

messages.context: Dean：Before finding the  Apprentice
messages.text: Please find my apprentice, he should be North of the Burning Desert.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 请找到我的学徒,他应该在烈焰沙漠北边。

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: You found my Apprentice and he WHAT?!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你找到我的学徒了,而且他怎么了!?

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: SULPHUR! This is catastrophic!!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 硫磺! 这下出大事了!!

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: My poor Apprentice, it is my vault, I shouldn't send him on difficult missions.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我可怜的学徒……是我的错,不该派他执行这么困难的任务。

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: This will also delay my work considerably, how am I going to obtain all those precious materials now...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这也会严重拖慢工作。现在上哪儿弄到那些珍贵材料……

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Oh, you are willing to help?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,你愿意帮忙?

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Well in that case, I will send you the list of items I need.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那好,我把需要的物品清单发给你。

messages.context: Dean：After finding the  Apprentice  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Thank you very much you are a life savior, quite literally.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 太感谢了,你真是救命恩人——字面意义上的。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving  10 Magma Chunk and  5 Burning Eye
messages.text: Let me know when you obtained the 10 Magma Chunks and 5 Burning Eyes.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 拿到 10 个岩浆块和 5 只燃烧之眼后告诉我。

messages.context: Dean：Giving  10 Magma Chunk and  5 Burning Eye
messages.text: Magma Chunks and Burning Eyes, perfect!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 岩浆块和燃烧之眼,完美!

messages.context: Dean：Giving  10 Magma Chunk and  5 Burning Eye
messages.text: That should be enough to finish my work.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这些应该足够完成工作。

messages.context: Dean：Giving  10 Magma Chunk and  5 Burning Eye
messages.text: I will call you once I'm done.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 做好后我会联系你。

messages.context: Dean：Before completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: Thank you very much %s, I will call you when I'm done
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 非常感谢,%s。完成后我会联系你。

messages.context: Dean：After completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: Oh, I was just about to call you!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,我正准备打给你呢!

messages.context: Dean：After completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: I have almost completed my research, however I need a few extra components.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 研究差不多完成了,不过还缺几个额外组件。

messages.context: Dean：After completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: Those ones are going to be tougher to obtain though.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只是这些东西会更难弄到。

messages.context: Dean：After completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: You will have to defeat mighty opponents.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你得击败一些强敌。

messages.context: Dean：After completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: The first ingredient I need is a Hallowed Skull, which is obtained from a Bladesoul.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 第一种原料是圣化头骨,要从 Bladesoul 身上取得。

messages.context: Dean：After completing  Odexar's quest
messages.text: This creature can be found inside the Stronghold, south of the island.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这种生物就在岛屿南边的要塞里。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving a  Hallowed Skull  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue) | Random
messages.text: Hallowed Skulls can be obtained from Bladesoul inside the Stronghold.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 在要塞击败 Bladesoul,就能获得圣化头骨。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving a  Hallowed Skull  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue) | Random
messages.text: The Stronghold was built by Blazes and Wither Skeletons, they are still expanding it slowly, quite fascinating.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那座要塞由烈焰人和凋灵骷髅建造,他们至今还在缓慢扩建。真是迷人。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Hallowed Skull
messages.text: A Hallowed Skull! Splendid!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 圣化头骨! 太棒了!

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Hallowed Skull
messages.text: I need a couple more components, the next one is a Lumino Fiber.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 还缺几种组件。下一种是光耀纤维。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Hallowed Skull
messages.text: Only the strongest of Blazes can create those, and there is a terrifying Blaze in the North West.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只有最强大的烈焰人才能制造它。西北方就有一只可怕的烈焰人。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Hallowed Skull
messages.text: If you can defeat them, I'm sure you'll obtain a Lumino Fiber.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只要击败它,肯定能拿到光耀纤维。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving a  Lumino Fiber  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue) | Random
messages.text: The reason why I need a Lumino Fiber? Well...it's hard to explain.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 为什么需要光耀纤维?这个嘛……很难解释。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving a  Lumino Fiber  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue) | Random
messages.text: I have reasons to believe there is a lot of Sulphur in the North, it would explain the appearance of those Blaze species.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我有理由相信北边蕴藏着大量硫磺,这也能解释那些烈焰人生物为何出现。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Lumino Fiber
messages.text: Thanks! I almost have all the components I need now.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 谢了! 现在几乎集齐全部组件了。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Lumino Fiber
messages.text: The last one is a Leather Cloth, and not just any kind.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 最后一样是皮革布,而且不能是普通货色。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Lumino Fiber
messages.text: There is a rogue Barbarian going by the name of Duke X.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 有个叛离阵营的野蛮人,名叫 Duke X。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Lumino Fiber
messages.text: He owns all the Leather Cloth on the island, find him and you'll find the items.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 岛上所有皮革布都在他手里。找到他,就能找到这种材料。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving a  Leather Cloth | Random
messages.text: Piglins can grow incredibly strong if they consume large amounts of Sulphur, but they lose their sanity in the process.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 猪灵摄入大量硫磺后会变得异常强壮,但也会逐渐失去理智。

messages.context: Dean：Before giving a  Leather Cloth | Random
messages.text: Last I heard, they are located near the Barbarian Faction.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我最后听说,他就在野蛮人阵营附近。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Leather Cloth
messages.text: I knew I could count on you.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我就知道可以指望你。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Leather Cloth
messages.text: This strong Cloth will be able to contain the skull and the lumino fibers together.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这种结实的布料能把头骨和光耀纤维固定在一起。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Leather Cloth
messages.text: In theory this should help refining Sulphur, if I can get it to work.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 理论上,它应该有助于精炼硫磺——前提是我能让它正常运作。

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Leather Cloth
messages.text: Would you mind talking to Captain Ahone?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 能去和 Ahone 队长谈谈吗?

messages.context: Dean：Giving a  Leather Cloth
messages.text: Please tell him I need a full backpack worth of Sulphur.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 请告诉他,我需要整整一背包的硫磺。

messages.context: Dean：Before defeating Kuudra | Random
messages.text: Captain Ahone should be below the Community Center.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Ahone 队长应该就在社区中心下方。

messages.context: Dean：Before defeating Kuudra | Random
messages.text: There is still so much to learn about Sulphur.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 硫磺还有太多秘密等待研究。

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Hello %s?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 喂,%s?

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: You found who stole our Sulphur?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你找到偷走硫磺的家伙了?

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: A giant magma creature with massive tentacles?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 是一只长着巨大触手的岩浆怪物?

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Well that explains a lot, my Apprentice just awoken from his coma, he described the same creature.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那就说得通了。我的学徒刚从昏迷中醒来,描述的也是同一种生物。

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: In a way it is good that the Piglins were not behind this.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 某种意义上,这至少说明幕后黑手不是猪灵。

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: We need to learn more about that monster, where it is from and what it wants.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们必须查清那只怪物的来历和目的。

messages.context: Dean：First interaction after defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: I will call you later!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 之后再联系你!

messages.context: Dean：After defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue) | Random
messages.text: This monster probably feeds itself with Sulphur.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那只怪物很可能以硫磺为食。

messages.context: Dean：After defeating Kuudra  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue) | Random
messages.text: If left unchecked, it is possible that the powers of this creature will grow.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 如果放任不管,它的力量很可能继续增长。
